Recruitment exam results announced for IB JIO-II/Tech and IISER IAT

The final results for the IB JIO-II/Tech recruitment examination for 2025 have been declared and are available on the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) website. Separately, the IISER IAT Result 2026 has also been released on the iiseradmission.in portal. These announcements provide lists of selected candidates for the respective examinations.
